title: Evidence the scale proof and lock suite sequencing after the readiness assessment

costar.context: The assessment plan suite_readiness_assess is approved. Engine scale phases are marked done; shippin.cloud, zoho-client, and license-choice are open. Docker and FoundationDB clients are required to re-observe scale_two_nodes.
costar.objective: Evidence-back two-node-shared, choose BSL so shippin.cloud can reserve hosted use, set zoho-client as the next product phase, and record that collaborative Docs stays out of scope until mail calendar contacts and admin exist.
costar.style: Operating-module updates, license file, product-boundary edit, and a journaled two-node proof.
costar.audience: The maintainer and the next coding agent.
costar.response: scale_two_nodes observed and journaled, license no longer deciding, zoho-client in progress, Docs deferred in the roadmap, organize.py --check exits 0.

concerns: scale_two_nodes needs Docker plus libfdb_c; a missing daemon makes the roadmap claim unobserved again.
Writing BUSL-1.1 without touching LicenseRef-SEL blocks must keep enterprise on the default build.
Choosing zoho-client first must not start collaborative Docs or a second mail server.
A check that only greps one file would miss a roadmap objective or phase left inconsistent.
context: The readiness assessment scored the engine strong and the mailcow/Zoho/Docs product surfaces weak. The attached plan's todos are the next moves.
current_state: Roadmap marks two-node-shared done without a journaled run. license is deciding. product-boundaries still say Current work is Scale. Docs is absent from the roadmap.
target_design: Journaled scale_two_nodes proof, BUSL-1.1 at the root and in crates/main/Cargo.toml, zoho-client in_progress as current work, Docs deferred by an explicit objective, license-and-scale and product-boundaries rewritten to match.
changes: Run STORE=FoundationDb cargo test -p tests --features scale -- --ignored scale_two_nodes and journal the result.
Set crates/main/Cargo.toml license to BUSL-1.1 and add a root LICENSE.
Rewrite license-and-scale.mdc for the BSL choice; leave SEL blocks and enterprise defaults alone.
Set zoho-client to in_progress; add a no-docs-yet objective; update product-boundaries Current work.
Leave shippin.cloud not_started until hosting work begins.
boundaries: Do not relicense SPDX LicenseRef-SEL blocks.
Do not remove enterprise from default or from Dockerfiles.
Do not add a webmail, Docs editor, Go control plane, or second MTA in this pass.
Do not edit the attached assessment plan file under /opt/cursor/artifacts/plans.
